Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a finished standalone illustration for EquipED specialist workspaces. The supplied image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: retain its crisp royal-blue outlined paper objects, restrained dimensional overlaps, connected amber page folds, and folded ribbon motif; create a fresh subject-specific composition. Do NOT create a web interface, screenshot, concept presentation board, icon sheet, logo, or text.
Art direction: mature editorial paper illustration, sharp geometric edges, consistent slender outlines, broadly flat solid fills with very restrained shading at paper overlaps. Highly composed, balanced and polished at 400px wide. Avoid photographic rendering and clay forms. Color family royal blue #1b3b87, deep royal blue #142f70, paper #fbfcfc, cool neutral #cad6da, slate #91a5ad, ink #1b2b33, amber #d9ad1d sparingly. No purple, teal or orange. No people, hands, faces, characters, graduation caps, open books, sparkles or blobs. No score charts, progress bars, approved badges or checkmarks. No legible words, letters, numerals or watermarks; print is represented by a FEW short deliberate rules, not dense dozens of lines.
Composition: landscape 3:2, one integrated asymmetrical object cluster occupies 70–80 percent, every object entirely visible with clear padding. Transparent background with clean alpha. Empty surrounding area must be genuinely clear; NO ambient glow, broad blurry shadows, painted checkerboard, floor, desk or backdrop. Tight opaque two-tone overlap shadows only. Do not reproduce the blurry halo around the reference. Keep visual richness in paper folds and overlapping shapes, not background haze.
SUBJECT SME CONTENT REVIEW: Main academic folio at a slight leftward tilt, one blue excerpt strip lifted slightly forward from the page, two small source annotation slips connected by a precise bracket to an amber highlighted sentence. A thin open circular focus ring in royal blue surrounds ONLY the relevant excerpt and is integrated with the annotation, with no magnifier handle. One folded blue paper ribbon passes behind the folio and through the lower left; a connected amber top corner balances the composition. The image should communicate careful content reading and source evidence. Make the main object arrangement distinct from the reference while preserving its visual family.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a reusable transparent abstract background accent for EquipED institutional workspace surfaces, a supporting asset rather than the main illustration.
Use the supplied image ONLY as visual-language reference for precise folded royal-blue paper ribbons and the palette. Remove all documents, annotation cards, printed rules and foreground content.
Create a spacious horizontal abstract composition, approximately 3:1 landscape, with a folded paper ribbon travelling across the LOWER THIRD from left toward right in four broad deliberate angular folds. Royal blue #1b3b87 and deeper #142f70 on alternating faces; two restrained cool-white #fbfcfc and neutral #cad6da folded planes tuck under the ribbon, and ONE tiny amber #d9ad1d folded tip. The top two-thirds must be empty transparent space suitable to sit behind interface text without competing. Keep the ribbon mostly near the lower edge but fully inside the image with padding; deliberately quieter and less complex than the reference. Geometric, architectural, academic stationery, mature editorial vector aesthetic, flat crisp facets and hard edges, no soft rendering.
Background MUST be true transparent alpha. No backdrop rectangle, fog, broad blur, glow, light rays, soft shadows, room, desk, objects, documents, UI, characters, lettering, words, numbers, logos, watermarks, gradients, sparkles, spheres or randomly floating pieces. Tight hard-edged shadow shapes only where paper faces overlap. Make the composition useful as one decorative low-emphasis accent; not a wallpaper covered in visual noise.
